import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack();return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), (g[True]-g[False])
e,per=est(w);print(e);print(per)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp]))[0])
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
# author cluster bootstrap
auth=w.author_key.unique();bs2=[]
gb=w.groupby('author_key').indices
for i in range(1000):
  s=rng.choice(auth,len(auth));idx=np.concatenate([gb[a] for a in s]);bs2.append(est(w.iloc[idx])[0])
print('author',np.percentile(bs2,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in [['high'],['high','medium']]: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence.isin(dc)])[0])
for o in w.origin.unique(): print(o,est(w[w.origin==o])[0])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(est(w[(w.year<1866)|(w.year>=1886)])[0])
p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet');ids=w[(w[c]>0)].sort_values('year')
print(ids[['work_id','year','genre']].head(3), ids[['work_id','year','genre']].tail(3))
pid=p.set_index('work_id').passage_id
print(list(pid[ids.work_id.head(3)]),list(pid[ids.work_id.tail(3)]))
"
